description: This file defines the NodeForegroundService class, which manages a foreground service for an Android app, including notification handling, service lifecycle, and interaction with runtime status. It also includes a data class Quint for internal data handling.

classes.name: NodeForegroundService
classes.description: Android foreground service managing notifications and runtime connection status.

classes.name: Quint
classes.description: Data class used internally to hold combined runtime status information.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes notification channel and starts foreground notification with runtime status updates.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands, including stopping the service.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up coroutine jobs and scope.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Creates notification channel for connection status.

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Builds notification with current status and actions.

methods.name: startForegroundWithTypes
methods.description: Starts foreground service with notification, updating if already started.
